items.title: 東都ベイ・ドライブ
items.caption: 1980s Japanese city pop, glossy and sophisticated. Clear, sweet female lead vocal in Japanese with soft backing harmonies. Funky slap bass, tight live drums with a gated reverb snare, bright Rhodes electric piano playing jazzy major seventh chords, clean chorus-effect rhythm guitar, punchy horn section stabs, shimmering analog synth pads, a smooth alto saxophone solo. Warm analog tape production. Breezy, romantic, a night drive along the bay.

items.title: ネオンの雨
items.caption: 1980s Japanese city pop ballad with a mid-tempo groove, moody and urban. Smoky, expressive female lead vocal in Japanese. Mellow Rhodes electric piano, round fretless bass, laid-back drums with soft gated snare, muted funk guitar, lush string synthesizer pads, a wistful electric piano solo. Melancholy but stylish, rain on neon streets late at night. Polished analog studio sound.

items.title: 終電のあとで
items.caption: 1980s Japanese city pop and AOR, smooth and mellow. Warm, relaxed male lead vocal in Japanese with layered falsetto harmonies in the chorus. Clean electric guitar with chorus effect, melodic bass, steady drums, glassy digital electric piano, soft synth strings, a tasteful melodic electric guitar solo. Nostalgic, gentle, walking home through the sleeping city. Polished analog studio production.

items.title: 汐見ブリーズ
items.caption: 1980s Japanese jazz fusion instrumental with a city pop feel. Bright lead electric guitar melody with chorus effect, funky slap bass, crisp tight drums, glassy digital electric piano, synth brass hits, a lyrical soprano saxophone trading the melody with the guitar. Breezy, sunny, optimistic, a seaside highway. Polished analog studio production. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.title: 歌舞路ライツ
items.caption: Early 1980s Japanese funk and boogie instrumental, city pop style. Driving slap bass and four-on-the-floor drums with handclaps, scratchy rhythm guitar, bright synth brass riffs, sparkling electric piano, a gritty tenor saxophone lead melody, analog synthesizer solo. Energetic, glamorous, neon nightlife. Warm analog tape sound. Instrumental, no vocals.

items.title: サマー・ハイウェイ
items.caption: 1980s Japanese city pop instrumental, light and resort-like. Sweet melodic lead on a clean electric guitar, soft Rhodes electric piano chords, smooth bass, relaxed drums with rim clicks and shakers, warm synth pads, vibraphone accents, a gentle flute counter-melody. Carefree, sunlit, a summer afternoon drive by the sea. Polished analog studio sound. Instrumental, no vocals.
